newsitem.title: CROATIA: Croatian stocks firm further, brewery sets records.
newsitem.headline: Croatian stocks firm further, brewery sets records.

text.p: Croatian stocks closed firmer on Thursday, continuing the summer bull run and Chilean brewery group Cervecerias' unit Karlovacka Pivovara broke a new price record.
* Of 19 issues 12 rose, three fell, three were flat and one traded for the first time.
* Volume rose to 25,898 shares, turnover more than doubled to 16.8 million kuna.
* Market debutant Rijecka Banka was the most active stock, selling 16,913 shares at 100 kuna each.
* Top gainer hotelier Arenaturist climbed 32 kuna or 29.9 percent to 139 kuna, selling 100 units in a single deal.
* Karlovacka closed 50 kuna higher at 650, down from the 652 peak it hit at mid-session. It sold 1,104 shares.
* Biggest decliner Dalmatinska Banka lost five kuna or 1.56 percent to 315 with 680 shares sold.
